description: Sixteen channel feed-forward compressor and limiter for a polyphonic cable, with its own settings per channel, a side-chain input, makeup gain and a wet-dry mix for parallel compression

params.text: Sets the attack time for the selected channel, 0 to 200ms
Sets the release time for the selected channel, 0 to 2 seconds
Sets the level above which the selected channel is compressed, in dB with 0dB at 10V; the default is at the top, so it has to come down before anything is compressed
Picks the compression ratio and knee for the selected channel: Limit, which is an infinite ratio hard knee, then 2:1, 4:1, 8:1 and 20:1, each with a soft-knee and a hard-knee setting
Adds makeup gain to the selected channel, 0 to 40dB
Bypasses the selected channel, passing it through untouched; every channel starts this way
Blends the compressed signal with the untouched one on the selected channel, 0 to 100% wet
Picks which of the channels the panel controls are editing; the other channels keep their own settings
Takes the level that drives compression on the selected channel from the side-chain input rather than from the audio input

inputs.text: The audio to be compressed, one channel of the cable per compressor channel
The signal the gain detector reads on any channel whose SC button is on, one channel of the cable per compressor channel

outputs.text: The compressed audio, with the same number of channels as the input

notes: a new Comp II compresses nothing: every channel comes up bypassed, so the Comp II button has to be switched on for a channel and its Thrsh knob brought down from the top of its travel
the module comes up in the Linked-stereo setting, where the sixteen channels work as eight pairs; the Stereo/mono item on the right-click menu is what changes that
the gain reduction meter runs 18 decibels top to bottom, with lines drawn at 6dB and 12dB of reduction
menu: Copy channel — puts the selected channel's settings on the clipboard
Paste channel — writes the settings on the clipboard onto the selected channel
Set all channels to current — copies the selected channel's settings onto every other channel
Initialize current channel — returns the selected channel to the settings a new module comes up with
Stereo/mono — Mono gives sixteen independent channels, Stereo eight pairs that share settings, and Linked-stereo pairs that share gain reduction too, holding the stereo image
Panel channels — labels the meters and the channel display 1-8, 9-16 or Group/Aux to match a Mind Meld mixer, and is greyed out in the Mono setting
